evals.prompt: Set up Tailwind CSS v4 in this Vite project and add one custom brand color token.
evals.expected_output: Uses tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/vite, configures the Vite plugin, imports Tailwind with @import "tailwindcss", and defines the token in @theme.
assertions: Does not create tailwind.config.js unless explicitly needed

evals.prompt: Fix this Tailwind v4 error: it looks like you're trying to use tailwindcss directly as a PostCSS plugin.
evals.expected_output: Explains that v4 uses @tailwindcss/postcss, updates dependencies/config, and keeps @import "tailwindcss" in CSS.
assertions: Removes tailwindcss as a PostCSS plugin
Does not recommend npx tailwindcss init

evals.prompt: In my Tailwind v4 React component, className={`bg-${color}-600`} doesn't work. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Explains static source scanning and replaces dynamic class construction with a map of complete class names.
assertions: Mentions that Tailwind scans source files as text
Does not rely on safelist as the primary solution

evals.prompt: Migrate a Tailwind v3 config with content, safelist, theme.extend.colors, and darkMode selector to v4 CSS-first configuration.
evals.expected_output: Moves theme tokens to @theme, source/safelist to @source and @source inline(), and dark mode to @custom-variant while noting @config only as temporary compatibility.
assertions: Uses @custom-variant dark for selector-driven dark mode
